zero_to_fit.name: Zero to Fit
zero_to_fit.summary: Foundational program perfect for beginners or those returning after a break.
zero_to_fit.description: Build consistent training habits, improve fitness level, and master the fundamentals safely with zero unnecessary pressure.
requirements: 100% beginner-friendly
Minimum 3 training days per week
Daily 20-30 minute walks (optional but accelerates results)
Aim for 7 hours of sleep when possible
Avoid using heavy weights in the beginning
Results depend on nutrition and training commitment

tone_your_body.name: Tone Your Body
tone_your_body.summary: Body sculpting program that highlights muscles while reducing fat without bulking.
tone_your_body.description: Focus on muscle definition and fat reduction for a toned, refined athletic silhouette.
requirements: Commit to 4 training days per week
Prioritize protein intake daily
Do not skip leg and core training
Track weight and photos weekly
Maintain a slight calorie deficit

burn_x.name: Burn X
burn_x.summary: Intense fat-burning program combining cardio, strength, and precision nutrition.
burn_x.description: Combines resistance training and cardio with a calculated nutrition system for visible, rapid results.
requirements: Commit to 5 training days per week
Follow calorie targets with precision
Drink 2.5-3 liters of water daily
Avoid high-sugar items and fried foods
Walk 8,000-12,000 steps daily
Consult a doctor if you have serious injuries

vip_fit_club.name: VIP Fit Club
vip_fit_club.summary: Fully personalized program tailored to your body, goals, and lifestyle.
vip_fit_club.description: Customized training and nutrition plan with continuous adjustments based on weekly progress and life changes.
requirements: Track weight and measurements weekly
Send progress updates regularly
Train 4-6 days per week based on plan
Maintain high nutrition compliance
Plan adjusted for travel and life circumstances
Results depend on consistency and commitment
